info.title: Smart Reading Coach API
info.description: REST API of Smart Reading Coach. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457). Send the language in the Accept-Language header (nl or en) to get translated error messages.

Role.description: What a user may do: students keep a profile, teachers follow students.

DesiredLength.description: How long the material may be.

ReadingStatus.description: Whether the student has read the title.

type.description: URI that identifies the kind of problem.

title.description: Short, fixed summary of the problem (the HTTP status text).

detail.description: Explanation for the user, in the language of the Accept-Language header.

instance.description: Path of the request that caused the problem.

token.description: JWT. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

id.description: Catalog id (MongoDB ObjectId as 24 hex characters).

title.description: Title of the book or article.

format.description: Format of the material, for example paperback or e-book.

themes.description: Themes of the book. Used to match the topics in a reading profile.

levels.description: Language levels this title is suitable for. Empty when unknown.

levelLabel.description: Level as written in the source list.

url.description: Link to the title, when there is one.

Suggestion.description: A recommended book with the reason why it was recommended.
